task_summary: Solve a DC-OPF with spinning reserve co-optimization from MATPOWER JSON data and produce a structured dispatch report
decomposition_rationale: The task naturally separates into three concerns: (1) parsing MATPOWER JSON and building network matrices, (2) formulating and solving the DC-OPF with reserves, and (3) post-processing results into the required report format. Separating parsing from optimization allows reuse and clear debugging boundaries.

skills.name: evo-grid-matpower-parser
skills.description: Parses MATPOWER JSON network data into structured Python objects, builds bus/gen/branch/gencost arrays with proper indexing, filters inactive components, constructs the bus susceptance matrix (Bbus), PTDF matrix, and generator-to-bus mapping matrix.
skills.responsibility: All data ingestion from MATPOWER JSON: external-to-internal bus ID mapping, status filtering for generators and branches, susceptance matrix construction, PTDF computation, incidence matrices, and cost coefficient extraction with correct polynomial ordering.
dr_sections: 2. MATPOWER Case Format and JSON Structure
5. Building the PTDF Matrix in Python

skills.name: evo-grid-dcopf-solver
skills.description: Formulates and solves the DC-OPF with spinning reserve co-optimization as a linear or quadratic program. Supports both scipy.optimize.linprog for linear costs and piecewise-linear approximation of quadratic costs. Handles generator limits, capacity coupling (Pg + Rg <= Pmax), nodal power balance, transmission constraints via PTDF, and system reserve requirements.
skills.responsibility: Mathematical formulation of the optimization problem (objective, constraints), solver invocation, and extraction of optimal decision variables (Pg, Rg, flows). Determines reserve requirement using standard capacity coupling (largest online generator).
dr_sections: 4. DC-OPF with Spinning Reserves as a Linear Program

skills.name: evo-grid-report-generator
skills.description: Post-processes DC-OPF solution results to compute line loading percentages, identify top-3 most loaded lines, calculate operating margin, aggregate totals, and produce the final report.json in the required schema.
skills.responsibility: All post-optimization computations: line flow calculation from PTDF and optimal injections, loading percentage computation (handling rateA=0), operating margin calculation, total cost/load/generation/reserve aggregation, and JSON report serialization.
